==Problem==
The eighth grade class at Lincoln Middle School has <imath>93</imath> students. Each student takes a math class or a foreign language class or both. There are <imath>70</imath> eighth graders taking a math class, and there are <imath>54</imath> eighth graders taking a foreign language class. How many eighth graders take ''only'' a math class and ''not'' a foreign language class?

<imath>\textbf{(A) }16\qquad\textbf{(B) }23\qquad\textbf{(C) }31\qquad\textbf{(D) }39\qquad\textbf{(E) }70</imath>

==Solution 1==
Since each student must take a math class, a foreign language class, or both, all the students who do not take a foreign language class take a math class.  So <imath>93 - 54 = \boxed{\textbf{(D)}\ 39}</imath> students take a math class but not a foreign language class. (The fact that <imath>70</imath> students take a math class is irrelevant.)

-hailstone, edited by j314andrews

==Solution 2==
Let <imath>x</imath> be the number of students taking both a math and a foreign language class.

By P-I-E, we get <imath>70 + 54 - x</imath> = <imath>93</imath>. 

Solving gives us <imath>x = 31</imath>.

But we want the number of students taking only a math class,

which is <imath>70 - 31 = 39</imath>.

<imath>\boxed{\textbf{(D)}\ 39}</imath>

~phoenixfire
:):):):):):)

==Solution 3==
We have <imath>70 + 54 = 124</imath> people taking classes. However, we over-counted the number of people who take both classes. If we subtract the original amount of people who take classes we get that <imath>31</imath> people took the two classes. To find the amount of people who took only math class, we subtract the people who didn't take only one math class, so we get <imath>70 - 31 = \boxed{\textbf{(D)} \, 39}</imath>. 

-fath2012

==Solution 4==
<asy>
draw(circle((-0.5,0),1));
draw(circle((0.5,0),1));
label("$\huge{x}$", (0, 0));
label("$70-x$", (-1, 0));
label("$54-x$", (1, 0));
</asy>

We know that the sum of all three areas is <imath>93</imath>
So, we have: 
<cmath>93 = 70-x+x+54-x</cmath>
<cmath>93 = 70+54-x</cmath>
<cmath>93 = 124 - x</cmath>
<cmath>-31=-x</cmath>
<cmath>x=31</cmath>

We are looking for the number of students in only math. This is <imath>70-x</imath>. Substituting <imath>x</imath> with <imath>31</imath>, our answer is <imath>\boxed{39}</imath>.

-mathnerdnair
